_retired: An entry with `retired: true` is never drawn again (rules/qiyu.mjs), but stays so a run already holding it rolled still finds its frame — 洛书 left the pool 10-19 (Hanli: 「9宫格出现一次就可以了」), 五子棋 took its weight.
_about: 奇遇 in a 秘境 rerun (rules/qiyu.mjs; Hanli 2026-10-19: 「秘境里可以有随机游戏. 设计一个剧情触发一下了」). Keyed by the rerun's beat id. As a run is entered each of its rooms rolls `chance` (≈ one room in three or four); a hit draws an entry by `weight`, never the game the room before drew nor the one the previous run drew last, and an entry that `needs: "her"` (你画我猜: 银月 names the picture) only while she is awake beside him on her own line. `task` is the board (tasks/world.json, `qiyu: true`); one of `frames` is its line on the board (facts, never her words); `words` names the drawguess word list (games.json drawguess data) the thing drawn is dealt from. A win pays a find drawn from the rerun's own `finds` (鼎苔 · 灵芝 · 人参 · 铜矿石), and its first clear ever the small-game 灵石 (balance.json `boards`). On a 测试存档, `rerun enter --qiyu=<task>` forces that entry into the first room.

frames.zh: 岔口那道刻着「凶」字的窄缝旁，还刻着半幅画，叫水蚀得只剩几道印子。照着补全，给银月认。
frames.en: Beside the narrow crack marked 凶 at the fork, half a picture is carved, worn by water to a few lines. Finish it, and let Yinyue read it.

frames.zh: 石阶边的崖壁上，前人拿刀刻过一样东西，刻痕叫青苔吃了大半。照着补上，叫银月认。
frames.en: On the cliff by the steps someone once cut a picture into the stone; moss has eaten most of it. Fill it back in for Yinyue to read.

frames.zh: 干了的河床里一块平石，前人在上头画过东西，水冲得只剩几笔。补上，看银月认不认得。
frames.en: A flat stone in the dry riverbed: someone drew on it once, and the water left a few strokes. Fill it in and see if Yinyue knows it.

frames.zh: 凶崖的石阶上，犰狳一只挨一只横在路上装死。袖子里还有一把豆子。
frames.en: On the cliff stair the armadillos lie across the way one after another, playing dead. There is still a handful of beans in your sleeve.

frames.zh: 干了的河床那头，有个人脸的东西在哭，像个娃娃；它身前的兽，一群一群。
frames.en: Far down the dry riverbed something with a man's face is crying like a baby; before it, the beasts stand in herds.

frames.zh: 岔口的石壁上刻着一道道符门，前人撒过豆子——地上还滚着几粒，是活的。
frames.en: Gates of talismans are cut into the wall at the fork; someone scattered beans here once. A few still roll on the ground, alive.

frames.zh: 碎石堵了岔口的一道口子，得一块一块挪开。把小满挪到下方缺口。
frames.en: Fallen stone blocks one of the mouths at the fork; it has to be shifted block by block. Get Xiaoman to the gap at the bottom.

frames.zh: 暗河的河床里卡着几截浮木和石块，挪出一条路来。把小满挪到下方缺口。
frames.en: Driftwood and stones jam the dry riverbed; work a way through. Get Xiaoman to the gap at the bottom.

frames.zh: 凶崖底下塌了半边，有只小兽困在石缝里。把小满挪到下方缺口，石头就让开了。
frames.en: Half the foot of the cliff has fallen in and a small beast is trapped in a crack. Get Xiaoman to the gap at the bottom and the stones give way.

frames.zh: 地上散着一地碎石板，拼回去是一幅刻画。
frames.en: Broken stone tablets lie all over the floor; put back together, they make a carving.

frames.zh: 石壁上的彩绘剥落了一地，捡起来拼回原样。
frames.en: The painting on the wall has flaked off onto the floor; fit the flakes back as they were.

frames.zh: 地上散着七片碎石板，拼回去是一道符。
frames.en: Seven broken stone tablets lie on the floor; put back together, they make a talisman.

frames.zh: 石壁上剥落了七块彩绘，捡起来拼回原样。
frames.en: Seven painted flakes have fallen from the wall; fit them back as they were.

frames.zh: 岔口那块平石上刻着纵横十五道，旁边两只石罐，一黑一白。罐底刻着一行字：「与石对弈，胜者自取。」
frames.en: On a flat stone at the fork, fifteen lines are cut each way, with two stone pots beside it, one black, one white. Cut in a pot's floor: "Play the stone. The winner takes."

frames.zh: 凶崖石阶半腰的平台上刻着一盘棋，边上倚着一具前人的枯骨，指骨里还捏着一颗白子。
frames.en: Halfway down the cliff stair, a board is cut into a ledge; beside it leans the bones of one who came before, a white stone still pinched in the finger bones.

frames.zh: 干了的暗河床上铺着一盘石子棋，黑白两色都是河卵石。棋盘边上刻着一行小字：赢一局，取一物。
frames.en: In the dry bed of the dark river a board is laid out with river pebbles, black and white. Cut along its edge: win a game, take a thing.

frames.zh: 石缝里卡着一只石匣，匣盖上刻着残缺的九宫。
frames.en: A stone casket is wedged in a crack, a broken nine-square carved on its lid.

frames.zh: 暗河边的石台上九个凹坑，数对了才肯开。
frames.en: Nine hollows in a stone ledge by the dark river; it opens only when the numbers are right.
